text: AccountManagerUtils resets with undefined and saves the default as undefined. FolderTreeProperties.setColor currently documents color as string even though the shared caller permits absence. When editing this API, include the reset/absence case in its parameter contract and tests. The source mismatch is a supported observation; changing the JSDoc is a proposed manual style correction, not an observed lint error or proof of a runtime failure.
title: Document undefined reset values where store callers use them
